extracted.intended_audience: users of GAP / computational group theorists who construct and manipulate tables of marks
extracted.subtask_description: Reference/manual guidance for creating, inspecting, and using 'table of marks' objects in GAP, including methods, attributes, printing, conversions, and interactions with subgroup lattices and character tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: TableOfMarks(G) preconditions
rubrics_metrics.description: In the first form, G must be a finite group, and TableOfMarks constructs the table of marks of G. This computation requires the knowledge of the complete subgroup lattice of G (see LatticeSubgroups (39.20.1)). If the lattice is not yet stored then it will be constructed. This may take a while if G is large.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect potentially expensive computation; the result has the IsTableOfMarksWithGens (70.10.3) value true.

rubrics_metrics.name: TableOfMarks(string) library lookup
rubrics_metrics.description: In the second form, string must be a string, and TableOfMarks gets the table of marks with name string from the GAP library (see 70.13). If no table of marks with this name is contained in the library then fail is returned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when you know the library identifier; otherwise TableOfMarks may fail.

rubrics_metrics.name: TableOfMarks(matrix) format and consistency
rubrics_metrics.description: In the third form, matrix must be a matrix or a list of rows describing a lower triangular matrix where the part above the diagonal is omitted. Not every such matrix describes a table of marks of a group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Necessary conditions are checked with IsInternallyConsistent (70.9.1); TableOfMarks returns fail if matrix is proved not to describe a matrix of marks, but even if it returns an object it may not describe the table of marks of a group.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methods chosen by group properties
rubrics_metrics.description: Different methods are used depending on group knowledge: for cyclic groups structure knowledge is used; if subgroup lattice is stored use TableOfMarksByLattice; if solvable, take lattice (compute if needed) and compute via TableOfMarksByLattice; otherwise use cyclic extension method computing table and conjugacy classes simultaneously.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware which method applies — this affects performance and whether conjugacy classes or lattice are stored afterwards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lattice <-> TableOfMarks conversion
rubrics_metrics.description: The lattice of subgroups of a group with known table of marks can be computed using the table of marks via LatticeSubgroupsByTom (70.3.3); conversely TableOfMarksByLattice computes the table from the subgroup lattice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Either structure (lattice or tom) can be used to derive the other when appropriate functions/attributes are available.

rubrics_metrics.name: ViewObj / PrintObj printing behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: ViewObj prints the string 'TableOfMarks' followed by, if known, the identifier or the group; if neither known then just the number of conjugacy classes is printed. PrintObj does the same but uses the group's PrintObj.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rely on Identifier or UnderlyingGroup to improve printed output; otherwise output will be generic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Display formatting and options
rubrics_metrics.description: Display(tom[, arec]) produces formatted output of the marks; each line begins with the number of the corresponding class of subgroups and repeats if output spreads over pages. The optional arec record may include 'classes' (list of class numbers to select) and 'form' (either 'subgroups' or 'supergroups' which changes interpretation of matrix entries).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use arec to select rows/columns or to switch between viewing contained-subgroup counts vs containing-supergroup counts; SizeScreen controls number of columns printed at once.

rubrics_metrics.name: SortedTom reordering constraints
rubrics_metrics.description: SortedTom(tom, perm) returns a table with rows/columns reordered according to permutation perm. In each table the matrix is assumed lower triangular; if perm does not preserve this property functions may return wrong results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure perm preserves lower-triangular ordering; the returned table stores only attributes known for tom and listed in TableOfMarksComponents (70.6.4).

rubrics_metrics.name: PermutationTom attribute semantics
rubrics_metrics.description: For tom stored with an UnderlyingGroup, PermutationTom is a permutation π such that the i-th conjugacy class of subgroups belongs to the i^π-th column and row in tom. It is only bound if tom was obtained from another tom by SortedTom.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This attribute preserves information about original ordering, necessary for computations (e.g., fusion maps) that depend on ordering.

rubrics_metrics.name: TableOfMarksByLattice behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: TableOfMarksByLattice(G) computes the table of marks from the lattice of subgroups of G; the lattice is computed via LatticeSubgroups if not stored. It is installed as a method for TableOfMarks for solvable groups and groups with stored subgroup lattice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this explicit function when you want to compute tom from a known lattice or force that method.

rubrics_metrics.name: LatticeSubgroupsByTom usage
rubrics_metrics.description: LatticeSubgroupsByTom computes the lattice of subgroups of G from the table of marks of G, using RepresentativeTom (70.10.4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when you have a tom and want to recover or inspect subgroup lattice structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: TableOfMarksComponents for conversion
rubrics_metrics.description: TableOfMarksComponents lists attribute names and getter functions used when creating a table of marks from a record via ConvertToTableOfMarks. It is used to map record components to table attributes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When building tom objects from records, ensure record contains components named in TableOfMarksComponents.

rubrics_metrics.name: ConvertToTableOfMarks requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: ConvertToTableOfMarks(record) converts a record with components from TableOfMarksComponents into a table of marks object with corresponding attributes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Construct record matching the TableOfMarksComponents layout to create tom objects programmatically.

rubrics_metrics.name: MarksTom and SubsTom compressed storage
rubrics_metrics.description: MarksTom and SubsTom store the matrix of marks in compressed form omitting zeros: SubsTom[i] lists positions of nonzero entries of row i; MarksTom[i] lists the corresponding marks. They are defining attributes of tables of marks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is no default method for SubsTom; default MarksTom needs NrSubsTom and OrdersTom if SubsTom is absent.

rubrics_metrics.name: NrSubsTom and OrdersTom interchangeability
rubrics_metrics.description: NrSubsTom stores numbers of subgroups (position (i,j) = number of subgroups of class j contained in one member of class i) in the same compressed way as MarksTom. OrdersTom returns orders of representatives of classes. One can compute NrSubsTom and OrdersTom from MarksTom and vice versa.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Either representation can be used depending on convenience/storage; conversion functions are available.

rubrics_metrics.name: LengthsTom meaning
rubrics_metrics.description: LengthsTom(tom) returns a list of lengths of the conjugacy classes of subgroups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for understanding conjugacy class sizes at a glance.

rubrics_metrics.name: ClassTypesTom heuristics
rubrics_metrics.description: ClassTypesTom distinguishes isomorphism types of classes of subgroups as far as possible from SubsTom and MarksTom: two subgroups are not isomorphic if orders differ; isomorphic subgroups must contain the same number of subgroups of each type. Each type is represented by a positive integer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a weaker notion than full isomorphism; treat types as heuristics derived from tom data.

rubrics_metrics.name: ClassNamesTom generic naming convention
rubrics_metrics.description: ClassNamesTom constructs generic names: non-cyclic class names are '(o)_{t}l' where o=order, t=type number, l=letter distinguishing classes of same type; omissions occur when unique. For cyclic classes parentheses and type may be omitted, general form 'o,l'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these generic names for display; be aware of omission rules when interpreting names.

rubrics_metrics.name: FusionsTom representation
rubrics_metrics.description: FusionsTom is a list of fusions into other toms; each fusion is [identifier_of_image_table, list_of_images_of_class_positions]. This attribute is mainly used for library tables.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library toms often contain fusion data; use to relate toms to each other.

rubrics_metrics.name: UnderlyingGroup availability
rubrics_metrics.description: UnderlyingGroup(tom) accesses an underlying group stored on tom. There is no default method to compute an underlying group if it is not stored.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Many operations (e.g., RepresentativeTom) require UnderlyingGroup to be set; prefer toms with underlying groups when reconstructing subgroup representatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: IdempotentsTom and IdempotentsTomInfo outputs
rubrics_metrics.description: IdempotentsTom encodes idempotents of the integral Burnside ring via a list l; IdempotentsTomInfo returns rec(fixpointvectors, primidems) where fixpointvectors are 0-1 vectors for primitive idempotents and primidems are decompositions in the rows of tom.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these to study perfect subgroup classes and primitive idempotents (Dress correspondence).

rubrics_metrics.name: Identifier semantics
rubrics_metrics.description: Identifier(tom) is a string used for printing and in fusions. If tom is from the GAP library it has an identifier; if constructed from a group with Name, that name is used. There is no default method otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide Identifier for clearer output and for use in fusion data.

rubrics_metrics.name: MatTom full matrix caution
rubrics_metrics.description: MatTom(tom) returns the square matrix of marks stored in compressed form; converting to full matrix may need substantially more space than MarksTom and SubsTom.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use MatTom only when needed; prefer compressed attributes for storage efficiency.

rubrics_metrics.name: MoebiusTom outputs and dependencies
rubrics_metrics.description: MoebiusTom computes Möbius values of the subgroup lattice (mu) and the poset (nu), and returns record with components mu and nu; 'ex' (expected values from poset) and 'hyp' (positions where they differ) are provided when derived subgroup position is uniquely determined (DerivedSubgroupTom).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ex and hyp may be absent if derived subgroup position is not unique; Moebius computations may use DerivedSubgroupTom.

rubrics_metrics.name: WeightsTom interpretation
rubrics_metrics.description: WeightsTom(tom) extracts diagonal entries of the matrix of marks (indices of subgroup in its normalizer).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Divide marks by weights to obtain numbers of conjugate supergroups; helpful for translating marks into subgroup counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsXXXTom properties
rubrics_metrics.description: Properties IsAbelianTom, IsCyclicTom, IsNilpotentTom, IsPerfectTom, IsSolvableTom have the same meaning as for groups; an optional sub argument returns the property for the sub-th class of subgroups of tom.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these to query structural properties either for the whole underlying group or for specific conjugacy classes of subgroups.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsInternallyConsistent consistency check
rubrics_metrics.description: IsInternallyConsistent(tom) decomposes all tensor products of rows of tom and returns true if all decomposition numbers are nonnegative integers, false otherwise. This provides a strong consistency check for a table of marks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to validate that a matrix of marks (or constructed tom) is algebraically consistent even if it may not come from an actual group.

rubrics_metrics.name: DerivedSubgroupTom output semantics
rubrics_metrics.description: DerivedSubgroupTom(tom, sub) returns either a positive integer i (the derived subgroups of class sub lie in class i) or a list l if the class could not be uniquely determined.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Results are computed with DerivedSubgroupsTomPossible and stored; non-uniqueness is indicated by lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: DerivedSubgroupsTomPossible and Unique attributes
rubrics_metrics.description: DerivedSubgroupsTomPossible is a list of possible derived-subgroup positions (integer or list) per class. DerivedSubgroupsTomUnique, when known, is a list of unique positions. There is no default method to compute Unique unless values are stored or become uniquely determined; it is set automatically when last missing unique value is entered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Understand that tom alone may not uniquely determine derived subgroups unless generator data is present.

rubrics_metrics.name: NormalizerTom and NormalizersTom approximations
rubrics_metrics.description: NormalizerTom(tom, sub) tries to find the class(es) of the normalizer of a subgroup in class sub, returning either class number or list of candidate classes that have the right size and contain the subgroup and all subgroups that clearly contain it as normal; NormalizerTom should never return an empty list. If tom knows the subgroup lattice (IsTableOfMarksWithGens true) normalizers are uniquely determined. NormalizersTom uses approximations across several classes and may return better approximations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect approximations when lattice/generator information is missing; prefer toms with generators/lattice to get unique normalizer answers.

rubrics_metrics.name: ContainedTom / ContainingTom semantics
rubrics_metrics.description: ContainedTom(tom, sub1, sub2) returns number of subgroups in class sub1 contained in one fixed member of class sub2. ContainingTom(tom, sub1, sub2) returns number of subgroups in class sub2 that contain one fixed member of class sub1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to translate marks into containment counts between conjugacy classes.

rubrics_metrics.name: CyclicExtensionsTom prime-based equivalence
rubrics_metrics.description: Two columns of tom are equal modulo prime p iff corresponding subgroups are connected by a chain of normal extensions of order p. CyclicExtensionsTom(tom,p) returns classes of this equivalence; second form accepts list of primes (default set = prime divisors of order of group).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Can be used to detect cyclic-extension relationships among subgroup classes; note that NormalizerTom does not currently use this information.

rubrics_metrics.name: DecomposedFixedPointVector usage and integrality
rubrics_metrics.description: DecomposedFixedPointVector(tom, fix) returns decomposition of a fixed-point vector into rows of tom corresponding to transitive constituents. Trailing zeros in fix may be omitted. The input may be any integer vector, but resulting decomposition need not be integral.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect rational coefficients when fix does not correspond to integer combination of transitive constituents.

rubrics_metrics.name: EulerianFunctionByTom functionality
rubrics_metrics.description: EulerianFunctionByTom(tom, n[, sub]) computes the Eulerian function (number of n-tuples that generate the underlying group G). If sub is given, computes Eulerian function of each subgroup in the sub-th class. For groups whose tom is known, this method is installed for EulerianFunction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use tom-based Eulerian computations when the table of marks is known for performance or convenience.

rubrics_metrics.name: IntersectionsTom via tensor decomposition
rubrics_metrics.description: IntersectionsTom(tom, sub1, sub2) determines intersections of groups in class sub1 with groups in class sub2 up to conjugacy by decomposing the tensor product of their rows of marks; returns list whose i-th entry is multiplicity of groups in i-th conjugacy class as intersection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to enumerate possible intersection conjugacy classes and multiplicities.

rubrics_metrics.name: FactorGroupTom for quotient toms
rubrics_metrics.description: FactorGroupTom(tom, n) returns the table of marks of the factor group G/N where N corresponds to the n-th class of subgroups of tom (i.e., a normal subgroup).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to obtain tom of quotient groups when the normal subgroup class is known in tom.

rubrics_metrics.name: MaximalSubgroupsTom and MinimalSupergroupsTom outputs
rubrics_metrics.description: MaximalSubgroupsTom(tom[, sub]) returns [list_of_positions_of_maximal_subgroup_classes, list_of_class_lengths]; when given sub returns same info for the sub-th class. MinimalSupergroupsTom(tom, sub) returns [positions_of_minimal_supergroups_of_sub, their_class_lengths].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these to find maximal subgroup classes of the whole group or minimal supergroups of a specific class.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsTableOfMarksWithGens filter meaning
rubrics_metrics.description: IsTableOfMarksWithGens expresses the union of IsTableOfMarks and HasGeneratorsSubgroupsTom and HasStraightLineProgramsTom. If set then tom can be asked to compute information not uniquely determined by tom alone (e.g., derived subgroups or normalizers).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer toms with this filter set if you need to reconstruct subgroup representatives or unique structural data.

rubrics_metrics.name: GeneratorsSubgroupsTom representation
rubrics_metrics.description: GeneratorsSubgroupsTom(tom) returns [l, mapping] where l is a list of group elements (in UnderlyingGroup) and mapping lists, for each class i, positions in l of generators of a representative of class i. Known for toms computed from groups and for those admitting RepresentativeTom.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when you need explicit generators for representatives; requires tom to carry generator data.

rubrics_metrics.name: StraightLineProgramsTom semantics and requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: StraightLineProgramsTom(tom) returns at position i either a list of straight line programs or a single program encoding generators of a representative of the i-th class in terms of standard generators of UnderlyingGroup(tom). There is no default method to compute them; they are known for toms in the GAP library.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Straight line programs allow evaluation of subgroup generators in different representations but require knowledge of standard generators of the target group/image.

rubrics_metrics.name: RepresentativeTom and generator-based variants
rubrics_metrics.description: RepresentativeTom(tom, sub) returns a representative subgroup of class sub when IsTableOfMarksWithGens is true. RepresentativeTomByGenerators(tom, sub, gens) returns a representative as subgroup of group generated by gens, checking whether mapping of standard generators to gens yields an isomorphism (returns fail if not). RepresentativeTomByGeneratorsNC omits checks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use ByGeneratorsNC when you trust gens to be standard to avoid overhead; use ByGenerators to get safety checks for debugging.

rubrics_metrics.name: FusionCharTableTom cases and limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: FusionCharTableTom(tbl, tom) determines fusion from an ordinary character table tbl to tom (classes of elements -> classes of cyclic subgroups). Three cases: explicit fusion stored on tbl (use directly); UnderlyingGroup values known and equal (compute from group); neither available (only necessary conditions checked and may return fail).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When neither fusion nor group info available expect non-unique results; use PossibleFusionsCharTableTom to enumerate possibilities. Options: fusionmap (parametrized approximation) and quick (stop when unique if true).

rubrics_metrics.name: PossibleFusionsCharTableTom behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: PossibleFusionsCharTableTom(tbl, tom[, options]) computes the list of possible fusions according to checked criteria; if FusionCharTableTom returns unique fusion the possible list has length 1; if FusionCharTableTom returns fail, the list length != 1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this when FusionCharTableTom returns fail to see all consistent fusions under current constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: PermCharsTom outputs & dependency on fusion
rubrics_metrics.description: PermCharsTom(fus, tom) or PermCharsTom(tbl, tom) returns transitive permutation characters from tom. In first form fus must be fusion map from character table to tom; in second form tbl must be the character table of the group. If fusion map not uniquely determined then fail is returned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure fusion is known/unique before calling; otherwise obtain fail.
